summary: Iteration 14 fully verifies (A) subtle scroll parallax on Travel gallery images via new ParallaxImage wrapper and (B) the cookieless first-party analytics stack. All 19 backend pytest cases pass (10 inquiries + 9 new analytics). Frontend E2E flow validated: pageview fires on page load and increments summary.totals.views; hash '#insights' opens the AnalyticsDashboard; wrong key shows 'Invalid access key'; correct key 'bill-insights-2026' renders 4 stat cards + Top sources + Devices; close hides the dashboard and clears the hash; a successful contact form submit triggers an 'inquiry' event that increments summary.totals.inquiries by 1. All regression items (hero, Western lightbox open/next/close, Journal modal open/Esc close, navbar without Prints, footer logo, contact email direct mailto link, loader appears then disappears, no Emergent badge, zero console errors) also pass.

analytics_endpoints.GET /api/analytics/summary?key=bill-insi: 200 with keys totals{views,inquiries,conversion}, last7, last30, topReferrers[], devices{mobile,desktop}
analytics_endpoints.device_detection: UA containing 'Mobi' correctly attributed to devices.mobile; default UA to devices.desktop
analytics_endpoints.topReferrers_aggregation: custom referrer host appears in topReferrers list after tracking

detailed_findings.pageview_on_load: views delta after fresh page load = 2 (single page load = 1 pageview; the +2 delta is from the extra reload done during the loader test setup — both /api/analytics/track calls returned 200 in dev tools).

analytics_dashboard_ui.wrong_key_error: Displays 'Invalid access key' (red-700) below the input; no data revealed
analytics_dashboard_ui.correct_key: Renders 4 stat cards labeled 'Total views', 'Views · 7 days', 'Inquiries', 'Conversion' plus 'Top sources' and 'Devices' sections
analytics_dashboard_ui.close_button: data-testid='analytics-close' clears window.location.hash and unmounts the dashboard
analytics_dashboard_ui.console_note: One console error is emitted for the wrong-key attempt — this is the intentional HTTP 401 response and is expected behavior (not a bug).

detailed_findings.inquiry_event_on_submit: Filled contact-name/contact-email-input/contact-message and clicked contact-submit → success toast 'Thank you — your message is on its way to Bill.' and inquiries count went from 3 → 4 (Δ=1) in the analytics summary. Form fields cleared afterwards.
detailed_findings.travel_parallax: All 4 travel-item-N images rendered inside ParallaxImage with naturalWidth > 0 (1700, 1700, 1600, 1355). Scrolling the page (top → bottom → top) caused no layout breaks or console errors. framer-motion useTransform y-offset (-7% ↔ 7%) applied correctly.

regression.hero_image: Renders (visible in initial screenshot; horse + cowboy)
regression.loader: data-testid='loader' appears briefly and is hidden within 1500ms as expected
regression.navbar: WORK · TRAVEL · JOURNAL · ABOUT · BOOK A SHOOT (no Prints link)
regression.western_lightbox: Opens on thumbnail click, next button cycles image, close button dismisses
regression.journal_modal: Opens on journal-item-0 click, closes on Escape key

critical_code_review_comments: Nit: /api/analytics/track has no server-side validation on the 'type' field — any string is accepted and stored (only 'pageview' and 'inquiry' are ever counted). Consider Literal['pageview','inquiry'] in the Pydantic model to reject junk events.

Nit: /api/analytics/summary loads up to 200 000 events into memory and does the aggregation in Python. For a portfolio site this is fine, but if traffic scales it should be switched to a MongoDB aggregation pipeline ($match + $group) — the underlying doc has 'ts' as an ISO string, so range filtering would need a Date conversion at write time.

Nit: AnalyticsDashboard stores the access key in localStorage under 'bf_ak' in cleartext. Acceptable since it's a soft private-view gate (not real auth), but worth calling out — anyone with browser access can read the key.
Nit (unchanged from iter13): success/error Sonner toasts still lack a dedicated data-testid — automation must fall back to text matching.
test_credentials: Analytics access key: bill-insights-2026 (from /app/backend/.env ANALYTICS_KEY). No user auth in this app.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ analytics events (pageviews + inquiries) written to db.analytics during pytest and UI runs, plus one UI-submitted inquiry document (email testui14_*@example.com) in db.inquiries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 introduces /api/analytics/track (public POST) and /api/analytics/summary (key-gated GET). Access key lives in backend/.env as ANALYTICS_KEY=bill-insights-2026. Frontend dashboard is mounted in App.js and toggled by window.location.hash === '#insights' — there is no router. Analytics events persist to db.analytics MongoDB collection. Contact form success calls track('inquiry') in Contact.jsx. TravelGallery.jsx now wraps each image in ParallaxImage.jsx (framer-motion useTransform). All 19 backend tests pass; test files are at /app/backend/tests/test_analytics.py and /app/backend/tests/test_inquiries.py. No open bugs.
